# Runbooks

These are deliberately uneven, like real runbooks. Some are accurate and useful,
some are vague, and at least one is stale and slightly misleading. That is on
purpose: a production agent has to use runbooks as a fallible source, weighing
them against live telemetry rather than trusting them blindly. An agent that
follows a stale runbook off a cliff is a failure mode worth teaching.

The `runbook_search` tool (chapter 6) searches this directory.
